paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Joshua in Ai khua ala a, ahihsegawp dimdem a, Jeriko khua leh akumpipa ahihsiat bang in Ai khua leh akumpipa leng ahihsegawp a, Gibeon a mite'n Israelte toh lemna bawl in, alak uah ateng sam uh, chih azak in, alauta mahmah hi.
heading: Amorte Zoh Ahi Uh

paite: Gibeon khua bel lianpi, kumpipa khopite lak a khat bang a lian ahi. Ai khua sang a lianzaw leh amite leng hattak ahih ziak un alau mahmah uhi.
Huaiziak in Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Jermuth kumpina Piram. Lakish kumpipa Japhia leh Eglon kumpipa Debir kiang ah,
"Hong pai unla, hong panpih un, Gibeon i va dou ding uh. Joshua leh Israel suante toh lemna abawl ngal ua," chi in athukhak hi.

Amorte kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa akikhawm ua, asepaih tengteng uh toh ahohtou ua, Gibeon kho zawn ah giahphual sat in adouta uhi.

Gibeonte'n Gilgal giahphual a om Joshua kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na sikhate hon nuse ke'n. Kintak in ka kiang uah hong tou in, hong panpih inla, hong hondam in. Singtang gam a teng Amor kumpipate kou hong dou ding in akikhawm uh," chi in ava hilh uhi.
heading: Gibeonte'n Joshua Ngetna

paite: Joshua leh akiang a gal dou thei mi tengteng leh mihat hangsan tengteng Gilgal a pan ahohtou uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau het ke'n. Na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Alak ua mi kuamah na ma ah adingh zou kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Joshua in amaute adou guih a; zankhua a Gilgal a pan ana hohtousa ahi.
TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah amaute ahihbuai gawpta a, Gibeon ah tampi athat a, Beth-horon zottouhna lampi ah adelh a, Azekah leh Makkedah kho pha in athat hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte ma ah ataikek ua, Beth-horon a pan apaisukna mun a a-om lai un, TOUPA'N van a pan gial lian pipi atung uah Azekah kho pha in akesak a, asi uhi. Israel suante'n namsau a asatlup sang un gial denlup atamzaw hi.
TOUPA'N Amorte Israel suante apiak ni in Joshua in TOUPA kiang h thu agen a; Israelte mitmuh in, "Ni, Gibeon kho tung ah dingh nilouh in; kha, nang leng, Aijalon Phaizang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.

Mite'n amelmate uh tung a phu alak masiah uh ni adingh daikinken a, kha leng a-om nilouh hi. Hiai thu Jasar laibu a gelh hilou hia? Huchi in van lai ah ni a-om nilouh a, ni khat sung vengveng tum thu angaihtuah kei hi.
TOUPA'N huchibang a mihing aw angaihkhiak ni, ama in a-om ngei kei a anung in leng a-om ngei kei; TOUPA'N lah Israelte adoupih ngal a.
Joshua leh Israelte agiahphual uh Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
Huai kumpipa ngate ataimang ua, Makkedah kokhuk ah akibu uhi.
heading: Joshua In Amor Kumpipate Nga Aman

paite: "Makkedah kokhuk a kibu, kumpipa ngate muh ahi uh," chi in Joshua hilh in a-om hi.
Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam suang lianpi khuk in sin unla, veng mite leng omsak un.
Noute bel om kei unla; na melmate uh delh unla, anungdalte that unla; akhua himhim uah lutsak kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah amau ahon peta ngal a," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joshua leh Israel suante'n athah bei khit ua, kulhbaangpi nei khuate a, a-omlaite atailut khit un,
mi tengteng Joshua kiang Makkedah ah galmuangtak in ahong kik nawn ua. Israel suante dem in kuamah in lei alok ngam kei uh.
Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam hong unla, kokhuk a pan ka kiang ah kumpipa ngate hon kaikhia un," achi hi.
Hichibang in ahih ua, kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa kokhuk a pan akiang ah ahon pikhia uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipate Joshua kiang a ahon pitak un, Joshua in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, amah toh kuan galdou thei mite lak a heutute kiang ah, "Hong pai nai unla, hiai kumpipate ngawng sik un," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, angawng uh ahong siksak uhi.
Joshua in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un. Hattak leh hangsantak in om un. Na dou uh na melma tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N hichibang in ahih ding," achi hi.
Huai khit in Joshua in amau asatzan a, athat a, sing dawn ah akhai a; nitaklam tan in sing dawn ah akikhai lai uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, akibukna kokhuk uah apailut ua, akokhuk kam suang lianpi in asin ua, tuni tan in leng a-om lai hi.

Joshua in huai ni in Makkedah khua ala a, akumpipa uh tan in namsau in alok a; huai khua a om tengteng asatlum vek a, khat lel leng hawi anei kei. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in, Makkedah kumpipa tung ah leng ahihta hi.
heading: Joshua In Amorte Gam Alakbeh Lai

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Makkedah a pan Libnah ah apai ua, Libnah khua adou uhi.

TOUPA'N huai khua kumpipa tan in Israelte khut ah apia hi. Huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng athat vek hi. Asung a om mi khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in akumpipa tung ah ahih hi.
Joshua Israel tengteng toh Libnah a pan Lakish ah apai ua, panmun khoh in asual uhi.
TOUPA'N Lakish khua Israelte khut ah apia a, ani nih ni in ala ua huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat vek ua, Libnah khote tung a ahih bang in ahihta uhi.
Bezer kumpipa Horam, Lakish khua panpih ding in akuantou a; Joshua in amah leh aheute nangawn khat mah leng hawi lou in athatgam vek hi.
Joshua Israel tengteng toh Lakish a pan Eglon ah apai ua, panmun akhoh ua; adou uhi.
Huai ni in ala ua, huai ni mah in huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat bei sipsip hi. Lakish kho tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
Joshua, Israelte tengteng toh Eglon a pan Hebron ah apai ua adou uhi.

Ala ua, huai khua, akumpipa, akhopel tengteng leh asung a om tengteng namsau a dou in athat vek ua, Eglon kho tung a hih bang in khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Akhua nangawn hihse vek in asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip hi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng Debir ah akihei nawn ua adou ua;

huai khua, akumpipa leh akhopel tengteng ala ua; namsau in adou ua, asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip ua; khat mah leng hawi anei kei uh. Hebron kho tung leh Debir khua leh akumpipa uh tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.

Huchi in Joshua in agam pumpi, tanggamte, simlam a phaizang leh mual gamte hihse vek in akumpipa tengteng uh athat vek a; khat mah hinghawi anei kei hi. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupiak bang in anak thei peuhmah ahihchimit vek hi.
Joshua in Kadesh-barnea a pan Gaza pha in, Goshen gam tengteng toh Gibeon pha in ahihse vek hi.
Huai kumpipate tengteng leh agam uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Israelte adoupih ziak in, Joshua in hun khat a alak vek ahi uhi.
Joshua leh Israel tengteng a giahphual Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
